name: Jezero regional terrain window
coordinate_convention: Mars planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude in [-180,180] (matches the USGS MOLA 463 m mosaic). Never drawn on Earth.
body_figure: Sphere, radius 3396190 m (as declared in the source GeoTIFF CRS)
crop_note: Raw crop is 40 km x 40 km (20 km window + generous buffer). Person 1 reprojects to a local metric grid and crops the 20 km window after derivatives.
limitations: Regional terrain reference at ~463 m native / 1000 m analysis scale; not a landing-safety or rover-navigation product.
Center is a planning seed, not a validated scientific claim.
